doc.description:
Danger detector for the TU Delft Cyberzoo.
The camera is in portrait orientation with the floor on the LEFT side. Processes the left dd_floor_strip_frac of the image width and divides it into Danger_DETECTOR_NUM_ZONES horizontal bands (rows). Each zone receives a danger score 0 (safe/green floor) to 100 (fully blocked). 0-24 = low, 25-49 = medium, 50-74 = high, 75-100 = critical
Green floor pixels are detected using simple YUV thresholds. Results are stored in danger_scores[] and can be read by other modules via danger_detector_get_scores().
This module does NOT yet steer the drone – it only computes the scores.

define.name: DANGER_DETECTOR_CAMERA
define.description: Camera device to use for detection

define.name: DANGER_DETECTOR_NUM_ZONES
define.description: Number of horizontal zones to divide the image height into

define.name: DANGER_DETECTOR_VERBOSE
define.description: Define to print zone scores every periodic cycle
